hint.text:
Parentheses are used to add extra information that helps to explain or clarify something in a sentence. The sentence must make sense if the extra information is removed.

Commas can be used to include extra information in more formal writing. They should only be used if there are not already too many commas used in the sentence.

instruction.text: Drag the commas to the correct place in the sentence.
